fix(utils/body,validator): normalize Content-Type media type for case-insensitive matching

summary.intent: Make parseBody() and validator() match form/JSON Content-Type media types case-insensitively while leaving parameters such as multipart boundaries intact (issue #5060, `Fixes #5060`).
summary.issue_fit: Partial — mixed-case JSON, urlencoded and multipart requests are now recognised, but parseBody() now fails after a handler has already called `c.req.formData()`, a case that worked at the base.
summary.coverage: All six changed files reviewed against the complete merge-base diff; callers in `src/request.ts` inspected. Focused vitest run once at the head for body, buffer, validator and request tests: 144 passed, 1 skipped. Reviewer probes of a `formData()`-then-`parseBody()` handler ran at the head (fails) and at the merge-base (works). One fresh-context verifier batch confirmed the finding. The run was offline; no forge state or CI was available beyond the supplied packet.

findings.title: Keep parseBody working after c.req.formData() has cached the body
findings.trigger: A handler awaits `c.req.formData()` and then `c.req.parseBody()` on a multipart or urlencoded POST, leaving only `bodyCache.formData` populated.
findings.impact: `parseFormData()` now calls `arrayBuffer()`, which re-serializes the cached FormData with a new boundary; it is then parsed with the original Content-Type. Multipart throws `Failed to parse body as FormData.` (500); urlencoded returns a garbage key holding the boundary text. The base returned `{a:'1'}` for both.
findings.change: In `parseFormData` in `src/utils/body.ts`, reuse `request.bodyCache.formData` when it is already set, and only take the `arrayBuffer()` and `bufferToFormData` path when it is not. Add a regression test for `formData()` followed by `parseBody()`.
findings.source: PR body `Fixes #5060`; base behavior of `parseFormData` calling `request.formData()`.

observations.fact: Codecov reported 76.47% patch coverage, with three uncovered lines in `src/utils/body.ts` and one in `src/utils/buffer.ts`.
observations.evidence: Supplied Codecov comment in the review packet (section 6).

requirements.evidence: src/validator/validator.ts:24-26 (`i` flag) and src/utils/body.ts:100 lower-case the media type only; but src/utils/body.ts:126-130 regresses parseBody after a cached formData()
src/utils/body.test.ts, src/validator/validator.test.ts and src/utils/buffer.test.ts add mixed-case urlencoded, JSON and multipart cases; vitest 144 passed
